raw_response:
I farm only 2 mu, so I will keep the wheat-maize rotation on all of it because that is the system I know best and it fits my land, labor, and water. Some people in my family work off-farm, so I will not do anything complicated or risky. I will use better seed for both crops, but I will keep the management simple and steady. For wheat, I will push for a stable stand through proper base fertilizer, a few key irrigations from the well, and basic pest control. For maize, I will use hybrid seed because I care most about a reliable harvest, and I will focus fertilizer and water around the stages that matter most. I will use rotary tillage because it is practical for my small farm and fits the wheat-maize cycle well. I am not chasing the highest possible yield; I am aiming for a harvest I can count on with costs and labor I can handle.
